mandate: C324 — test the cross-sectional intraday AMIHUD-ILLIQUIDITY SEASONAL DISLOCATION mean-reversion statistical-arbitrage family on 10 USDT-M linear perps at native 5m (864 pre-registered configs). Signals (score = -seasonal-dislocation, short above-baseline illiquidity / long below): illiq_dev (|log_return|/notional vs trailing same-tod mean), illiq_ewm (illiq vs causal ewm same-tod mean), tc_dev (log trade_count vs trailing same-tod mean). Single-leg dollar-neutral perp PnL with costs on turnover (symmetric and perp_heavy). Gates: Holm+BH at alpha=0.05 (BOTH), MDE, stability, and illiquidity-vs-placebo attribution. PRE-REGISTERED zero-activity NaN policy applied (illiq NaN where notional<=0; log_tc NaN where trade_count<=0; NaN-aware same-tod trailing stats, min_periods=L; NaN-feature assets weight 0).

methodology.buckets: bar-of-day (tod)=seconds-of-day//300 (0..287), exact 288 bars per UTC day.
methodology.illiq: illiq=|log_return|/notional (NaN where notional<=0); log_tc=log(trade_count) (NaN where trade_count<=0). PRE-REGISTERED zero-activity NaN POLICY; NaNs only at zero-activity bars (<0.1%).
methodology.signals: illiq_dev=-(illiq-mean_L(illiq@tod)); illiq_ewm=-(illiq-ewm_mean_L(illiq@tod)); tc_dev=-(log_tc-mean_L(log_tc@tod)). lookback L days = trailing L seasonal occurrences, min_periods=L, NaN-aware (exclude NaN obs), fail-closed. score=-dislocation; causal shift(1), cross-sectional rank, dollar-neutral gross 1.0; NaN-signal assets weight 0.
methodology.pnl: single-leg perp: pnl = sum_i pos_i * perp_ret_i.
methodology.costs: charged on turnover; symmetric = fee+slip; perp_heavy = 1.5*fee+slip.
methodology.missing_data: non-finite -> NaN; never impute/ffill; insufficient valid obs -> NaN -> not traded (fail-closed).
methodology.multiple_testing: one-sided paired t-test of per-split OOS net vs 0; Holm step-down AND Benjamini-Hochberg over all 864 configs at alpha=0.05.
methodology.attribution: reference config signal nets vs illiq_placebo (per-asset permuted returns, same positions); shares=|net|/sum(|buckets|).
methodology.stability: sign consistency >= 0.70 of splits AND first/second-half Sharpe corr >= 0.5.
